answer: Every agent that wants a vote must first lock a refundable deposit; the deposit is slashed when two identities are proven to share one operator. A hollow shell with no deposit gets no voice at all, while a violet seal marks accounts whose deposit has survived many rounds unchallenged. A nebula of look-alike accounts would each need its own deposit, so cloning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits, and the slashing rule turns the flood into a loss instead of a gain.
